typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black tracking-tight leading-none text-black

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-4, p-6 for mobile containers
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-3xl for main panels/bottom sheet, rounded-xl for inputs and buttons
layout_and_spacing.container_style: Flat, high contrast, 1px border (border-gray-200) instead of blurry shadows.
layout_and_spacing.bottom_sheet: Fixed to bottom, rounded-t-[32px], bg-white, subtle top shadow shadow-[0_-8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] and z-50

components.buttons: h-14 px-8 rounded-xl font-bold text-lg transition-transform active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2
components.inputs: h-16 px-6 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 text-lg font-medium focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black focus:border-black outline-none w-full
components.quick_destination_card: flex items-center gap-4 p-4 rounded-xl bg-white border border-gray-100 hover:border-gray-300 transition-colors cursor-pointer w-full

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle border color change, zero layout shift

icons.style: weight='fill' for active/primary icons (like Home/Work), weight='bold' for standard UI outlines

specific_design_rules: COMPLETELY REMOVE the floating plus button at the bottom right. It causes clutter.
Start screen must follow the '3-Tap Booking Rule'. Large 'Where to?' (Wohin?) input takes absolute priority on the bottom sheet.
Visual Anchoring: Use clear, bold icons in circular colored chips for quick destinations (Home, Work, Airport).

Dynamic Location Logic (CRITICAL): Do NOT hardcode 'Berlin' or 'BER' for the airport/train targets. Implement a mocked state (e.g. currentRegion) that dynamically renders the correct target. (Example: If region === 'Kosovo' show 'Kosovo Airport'. If region === 'Berlin' show 'BER').

Map Area: The upper 50% of the screen should be reserved for the map background. If a real map isn't available, use a solid #F3F4F6 background with a grid pattern and a central 'current location' marker.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g. data-testid='where-to-input', data-testid='quick-dest-airport').

map_placeholder.description: Stylized map texture, can be heavily blurred and overlaid to simulate a map background if required.

taxi_marker.description: Taxi context image, can be used for ride type selection thumbnails if applicable.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a completely redesigned mobile-first Taxi App start screen in Javascript (.js). Delete the existing messy layout and the floating plus button. Build a 100vh layout: Upper half is a map area (mocked with background and center pin), lower half is an overlapping bottom sheet (rounded-t-[32px]). Inside the bottom sheet, place a prominent 'Where to?' input field. Below that, map a list of Quick Destinations (Schnellziele). Ensure the logic for Airport/Station is dynamic based on a mocked 'userRegion' variable—do not hardcode 'Berlin'. Use Archetype 4 styling: high contrast, no muddy shadows, stark black and white with Taxi Yellow (#FFD500) accents. Ensure strict adherence to the data-testid rules for all interactive elements.
